name: jyhess
description: Opinionated Claude Code plugins of Jyhess: clarify before building, set up projects with shared conventions, track work and document it

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: clarify, pilot and project-init skills, and the hooks that keep dev-kit up to date, inject a project's domain vocabulary and keep sessions short

plugins.name: dev-journal
plugins.description: Hourly work journal shared by several machines, kept in a private Git repository: the hook that asks about unlogged working hours, and the hourly skill that writes the entries from local activity

plugins.name: tracking-linear
plugins.description: Track a project in Linear: split work into tickets, implement a ticket up to the PR, step reviews and decision points with the points done and the work journal's hours

plugins.name: tracking-github-issues
plugins.description: Track a small project in GitHub issues: split work into issues, implement an issue up to the PR, without points or time

plugins.name: docs-wiki-github
plugins.description: Document a project in a wiki kept as a GitHub repository: page and folder structure, file names, links, Mermaid, index page, and a link checker

plugins.name: docs-folder
plugins.description: Document a small project in a docs/ folder of its repository, in English, kept up to date from the project's update table

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Write the user's professional communications (LinkedIn posts, announcements, professional mails) in their own voice, from their private voice profile, and tell whether a text was reworked by AI
